I'm really not happy but can't justify spending almost HALF of what I paid to send it back. MAJOR disappointment.  ***update*** 3/29/17  So after my initial review on this cup expressing my extreme disappointment with the so-called spill proof lid, I was contacted buy a customer representative from Gus. reviews.t: The GUS 30 oz is a homerun for me!
reviews.x: I bought this mug to use at work for cold drinks, but I tried it out at home and like it so much, that it will probably stay here until I get a second GUS 30oz mug, this time for work.  A side note, my cat is also named Gus, which is why I originally ordered this mug  On my first use after washing, I filled it about 2/3 full with ice and then some soda, all evening the ice remained and before bed, I filled up with soda again and ended up leaving about half in the tumbler. reviews.t: Better than yeti
reviews.x: Stays colder than my yeti. Originally bought it just because my husband's name is Gus, but it actually keeps ice longer than my yeti.

reviews.t: Great Cup, Keeps drinks nice and cold, well made
reviews.x: After having a few plastic, sweatless cups break or crack, I decided to give a metal cup a try.  The Yeti's look nice but a expensive.  Saw this one on Amazon, much cheaper and with very good reviews.  Plus it comes with two lids (sippy and one you can close the tab) which are BPA-free and a nice metal straw.  Yeti comes with just one lid, no straw.  After I got it, the company contacted me and offered me a nice black handle for free, which I gladly accepted and use all the time.  I really love

reviews.t: The lids leak.
reviews.x: It leaks immediately upon tipping. I might have expected some leaking from the slider mouthpiece but not from all other sides of both lids. Also disappointed that a straw cleaner didnt come with as it is pictured in the Amazon ad. As for it keeping ice for 24 hrs, I will update later. UPDATE:  Only keeps ice for @ 12 hrs but that is probably due to adding drinking liquids to it throughout the day.  I have not tried hot liquids yet.

reviews.t: Get On The Gus Bus!
reviews.x: A great tumbler!  I have a Yeti also and this is every bit as "quality" with the bonus of the extra slide lock lid and the stainless straw on top of the "regular" style lid, with a price that is oh so nice!

reviews.t: Great Mug - sliding lid will not stay open or closed. With Sipping lid EXCELLLENT!
reviews.x: I have tea that is warm through the first half of the day and a cold drink through the second half of the day. But now it is easy to drink! I recently upgraded this mug with a very comfortable [[ASIN:B01A7VKQD2 Thermik Handle for Yeti Rambler 30 oz Tumblers, Rtic, Ozark Trail and more (Black)]] The only negative is that the second sliding lid will not stay closed, and the opening on it with the cutout for the SS straw is way to big and it moves a ton, it fits better in the regular sipping lid. reviews.t: Keeps drinks cold in 100 degree temperatures
reviews.x: Bought 2 of these and couldn't be happier.  I use one for strictly water consumption.  I leave on night stand and have cold water all night long. Also leave in hot car in FL sun and still full of ice hours later. Ice does melt within 12 hours if water level is higher than ice level, basically all the way full. If water is 1/2 an inch from full then ice lasts vdery long.  I have not tried to see how long ice lasts but I have gone over 16 hrs and still have ice. I've had the ice completely melt  (

reviews.t: GUS 30 oz stainless steel tumbler
reviews.x: I like the tumbler, although my hand is too small to grasp the top which makes it a little inconvenient.  It does keep the correct temperature for quite a long time.  If ice is used, there is no moisture on the outside, though it is cold to the touch.  A positive comment is that it holds a large quantity of liquid! The picture shows what appears to be a brush for the straw, though there was not one enclosed with my order.

reviews.t: Best tumbler hands down
reviews.x: After researching all the tumblers amazon had to offer I took a chance with the Gus and I couldn't be happier. I didn't want to purchase a tumbler like the yeti for the main reason that it was to expensive and I felt that I was pretty much paying for the brand and not the product. The price for this tumbler is unbelievable, I'm really glad with my purchase and already recommended it to my friends and fellow coworkers.

reviews.t: Awesome!
reviews.x: Keeps water cold even without too much ice. I tested it vs similar tumbler I bought at Costco and GUS won. With same amount of water and ice in both, after 20 hours temperature in Costco's tumbler was 64F - GUS very cool 39F. Also, Costco's tumbler didn't fit in the cupholder - GUS fits nicely. Costco's lid was too tight and difficult to remove - GUS's just right.

reviews.t: It Works!
reviews.x: I am a homecare nurse and I my car all day.  My car sits in the hot sun for many hours a day while I am with my patients.  I put Ice water in the cup in the morning and there is still some ice left when I get home 8 to 9 hours later.  Best I have ever had at half the cost of a Yeti!

reviews.t: Good for the price, overall ok
reviews.x: Ice I put in this cup melts just a few hours later, however the water stays pretty cold. It's fine for what I need and the price is good but I'm a little disappointed after reading reviews. I have no tried it with hot beverages so I can't comment on how well it keeps things hot.

reviews.t: Better then expected
reviews.x: The vacuum insulated tumbler is better then I expected at keeping liquids hot! I take hot tea from home to work and drink it after about 2 hrs from preparation time, and its still HOT! This is recommended for all who want to enjoy their drinks - hot or cold.

reviews.t: I like this tumbler but it doesn't have the exact same ...
reviews.x: I like this tumbler but it doesn't have the exact same dimensions as Rtic, Yeti, etc, so a replacement lid I bought didn't fit.  Other than that, it works fantastic at keeping liquids cold at a great price.

reviews.t: ... - Comes with 2 lids and a straw - Glad I purchased 2 GUS 30 oz Tumblers
reviews.x: Thinner walls than another tumbler I purchased however no discernible difference noted in its ability to keep liquids cold - Comes with 2 lids and a straw - Glad I purchased 2 GUS 30 oz Tumblers!

reviews.t: Perfect
reviews.x: Just spend a week in muggy, hot Mexico at an all inclusive resort.  Beer and drinks get warm very quickly in this environment and this mug kept drinks cold for hours.  Perfect!

reviews.t: Impressed but came with no straw.
reviews.x: Just recently received the Tumbler and am with its appearance and construction. I am giving it only a four-star rating because it did not come with a straw as advertised.

reviews.t: Perfect for people who spend a lot of time on the road!
reviews.x: Perfect for my sister who is a home care nurse who works 12 hour days. She always has her hot coffee when she needs it! It's large enough that is lasts her all day long.

reviews.t: Best insulated cup ever
reviews.x: Had cup filled with ice around lunchtime left it in the car over night came back next morning omg ice is still in the cup! Best insulated cup ever

reviews.t: Great tumbler for less.
reviews.x: A great quality product at a great price.  Just proves quality doesn't have to be expensive.  I'm talking to you Yeti!

reviews.t: Love it and the great price
reviews.x: Bought this about a week ago and have been using it. Love it and the great price. Helps that my name is gus.

reviews.t: I love my cup, no more warm drinks!
reviews.x: This cup is great, I actually ended getting another one for my husband.  It keeps drinks cold over 24 hours with ice in the cup, I actually did an experiment with filling it up with ice and a drink and the ice remained for 32 hours.  I really like the metal straw and the 2 different lids they give you.  It is a great price and you get a lot for the price as I researched many other similar cups on Amazon.  I am very happy with my purchase.  I got the silver and it is a great looking cup that you

reviews.t: Excellent Value & Actually works better than advertised
reviews.x: This product is awesome.  Ice stays forever and if you add refrigerated liquid it stays cold and doesn't melt the ice.  No condensation on the outside of the glass!!!  EVER!! Glass doesn't even feel cold to the touch.  It includes 2 Tops including one that has the sip slider that can effectively close the lid and a stainless steel straw.  Works really well for coffee as well, but I am amazed by what it does for cold drinks. We use a ton of ice in the summer, and I've tried every type of coaster

reviews.t: The smaller bottom side also makes it easy for my small hands to grasp it
reviews.x: My son purchased this for me for Mother's Day.  My first thought was that while I appreciated his thoughtfulness I didn't think I needed another travel cup.  After using this cup I have thrown all of the other travel cups away.  This cup keeps my beverages cold and the ice doesn't melt even when I leave the cup in the car during the day or on my night stand at night. claims.text: Keeps drinks cold for a long time, often outperforming or matching pricier brands like Yeti.
Good value for the price, especially compared to more expensive brands.
The lids leak, particularly the slider mouthpiece and around the edges.
Well made and good quality construction.
